description: Deterministic rolling live-window SegmentBase/SIDX evolution contract for bounded dynamic polling.
anchor_requirement: After the first non-empty window, at least one stable retained leaf must form an exact prior-suffix / updated-prefix identity anchor.
accepted: stable-offset prefix eviction with retained suffix identity match
pure prefix eviction with empty append set and non-empty retained anchor
final dynamic-to-static snapshot that includes an anchored rolling window
rejected: completely disjoint non-empty prior->updated windows (unanchored full-window replacement)
a live window that rolls completely between polls with no retained leaf
live-edge rewind/shrink that retains a leading identity while dropping a trailing retained leaf
reorder or insertion that cannot form a retained suffix/prefix alignment
replay of an already-accumulated leaf identity after eviction
overlapping absolute byte ranges on the same media URL
duplicate leaf identities inside one window
honest_limitations: polling completes before media download; evicted historical ranges must remain HTTP-fetchable
identity does not hash remote bytes behind an unchanged URL/range
equal-sized absolute-range reuse can alias an unchanged window under URL/range identity
window size 1 must retain that leaf across polls or evolution fails closed
pinned yt-dlp does not implement dynamic SIDX polling; contract is Go-native
